en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a hilly landscape. The foreground shows solid masonry townhouses and a large brick institutional building, with streets radiating from a central junction where a horse‑drawn cart is visible. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "Eibenstock Rundblick 7".
